results.name: Phone mode is on (flagged for this page) and marks the page
Lighter rendering: no antialiasing, 1024 shadows, lighter grass and water mirror
Clutter is hidden: title, field notes, keyboard help, Run button and the old action button
On foot: joystick, Jump and Punch show; Brake does not
Pushing the stick all the way runs; part way walks
Walking, the camera swings round behind the way you are going
Right after a look drag the camera is left where you put it
The Punch button throws a punch
By the driver door one context button offers "Get in"
Driving: Brake and Get out show; Jump and Punch do not
Driving, the camera eases back behind the car
On the lookout deck the context button offers "Use rifle"
Tapping it lies down at the rifle; the joystick and jump/punch give way to Scope / Fire / Get up
Upright: the "turn your phone sideways" card covers the game and drawing pauses
